name: Project Gutenberg plain-text editions: Pride and Prejudice (#1342), Moby Dick (#2701), The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes (#1661), A Tale of Two Cities (#98), Frankenstein (#84), Little Women (#514)
license: Public domain in the USA (works published before 1929). The Project Gutenberg License covers only the PG trademark and header/footer; build_snapshot.py strips the header and footer and every line mentioning Gutenberg, so the snapshot carries no PG trademark text.
derivation: build_snapshot.py: strip PG header/footer, unwrap paragraphs, drop paragraphs with @/URLs/'gutenberg', skip first 20 paragraphs, split paragraphs > 1500 chars at sentence ends, consecutive chunks of >= 1800 words (<= 40 per book)
